study type: population-based retrospective cohort data linkage study
cohort: 70,425 births to women aged 15-44 years in the Northern Territory, Australia, from 1999 to 2017.
finding: Maternal mental health-related hospitalization prior to or during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of adverse birth outcomes, including stillbirth, preterm birth, low birth weight, and short birth length, in both Aboriginal and non-Aboriginal women.
birth_weight: low birth weight was an outcome
